name: Mojahed Ibrahim
headline: I build web apps and the databases and reports behind them.
lede: Seven years of PHP, JavaScript, SQL and Java on business software. At Turn 14 Distribution I built the PHP and MySQL apps behind a B2B e-commerce site and a warehouse management system. At Comcast I look after about 15 daily reports that run over millions of records, and I make the slow ones fast.

photo.alt: Mojahed Ibrahim in a navy suit and tie, smiling outdoors

highlights.label: MySQL tables I designed and tuned at Turn 14, averaging 700K+ rows each
shipping production code, from PHP web apps to enterprise reporting
cut from the daily reporting run at Comcast by running reports in parallel
less runtime on one report after I rewrote its query, indexes and joins

education.summary: A business degree with a technical major. I studied Management Information Systems at Temple's Fox School of Business and tutored for the department before I graduated.

teaching.text: Before graduating I worked for the MIS department as a tutor for its Data-Centric Application Development course, helping students with SQL, PHP, HTML and CSS.
